title: Trailer-Genobi (the owner's own track, bundled with permission)
measured: 2026-10-30, with shared/audio-analysis.ts (the code behind genobi audio-analysis and the Editor's beat grid); local CPU, nothing paid

sectionChanges.why: Not every change is a drop the analyser reports: the per-bar NumPy pass in docs/genobi-teaser.md found the biggest change on beat 92 (+15 dB) and the low band dropping out at 136-140 and 232-236; 12, 20 and 260 are the title, the first picture and the end card.

cut.rule: The bundled track starts with 37 ms of silence, so a bar line falls on frame 0 and cut beat 4 is the first downbeat (4 x 60 / 135 = 1.778 s, measured 1.775 s). A cut beat is seconds x 135 / 60.
